name: Facet
text: Ship EXCAVA with system preference as the default dark mode, but add a persistent toggle in settings. This matches the dark themes of Manus and Graphify, ensuring consistency with user expectations and reducing visual fatigue during long sessions. The trade-off is a slight increase in initial setup complexity, but the benefit of immediate familiarity outweighs it.

name: Pane
text: The real risk is locking users into a choice they may regret—once they toggle dark mode, they’re stuck with it unless they dig into settings. Instead, ship a one-time selector that remembers their preference but lets them change it anytime without friction. Settle it by testing both: measure how often users switch modes and whether they abandon the tool after toggling.
